messages:
maria: quick heads-up: noticed SDKs emitting different payload shapes for optional params (stop sequences, stream) — could change model outputs
sam: which params exactly?
maria: stop sequences and the stream flag. TS often sends an explicit empty array for stopSequences, python omits the key when unset
ashley: repro from TS: 
```
client.generate({ model: 'r-infer-1', prompt: 'hi', stopSequences: [] })
// payload -> { \"model\": \"r-infer-1\", \"prompt\": \"hi\", \"stopSequences\": [] }
```
ashley: python call with no stop: 
```
client.generate(model='r-infer-1', prompt='hi')
# payload -> {\"model\":\"r-infer-1\",\"prompt\":\"hi\"}  # no stop_sequences key
```
ben: server semantics: missing key => use builtin stops; empty array => explicit disable of builtin stops. So TS can disable builtin stops unintentionally
sam: second issue: stream default. TS gen often sets stream=false explicitly; python omits and runtime defaults to true in some older shims. Leads to streaming vs non-streaming mismatch
maria: root cause seems to be codegen + serializer decisions about defaults vs absent fields
ashley: quick mitigation idea: SDKs should only emit fields when user explicitly sets them (undefined/None => omit). Also make stream default explicit in SDK layer rather than relying on server fallback
ben: agree. Also update API docs to state semantic difference: missing == fallback to builtin stops, [] == explicit empty override. Add note about stream default behavior and recommend explicit setting
ci-bot: created ticket INF-7322: "SDK payload emission: undefined vs explicit empty collection causes runtime divergence" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7322
maria: owners: sam -> python, ashley -> ts, ben -> docs/compat. Can we add cross-SDK smoke tests?
sam: i'll add python tests to check serialization omits None fields and that dataclass defaults are None (not [])
ashley: i'll patch TS generator: when building payload only assign if opts.stopSequences !== undefined and opts.stream !== undefined. Will add unit test to assert JSON doesn't contain unset keys
ashley: snippet I'll use in generator: 
```ts
const payload: Record<string, any> = { model, prompt }
if (opts.stopSequences !== undefined) payload.stopSequences = opts.stopSequences
if (opts.stream !== undefined) payload.stream = opts.stream
```
sam: python helper: 
```py
def _strip_none(payload):
    return {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if v is not None}
```
ben: docs plan: add section in API spec clarifying missing vs empty collection behavior and stream default. Also call out internal consumers who might rely on explicit empty arrays
maria: ashley, Ben: please enumerate internal consumers before changing generator behavior. Ashley, add migration note in PR. Ben, coordinate compat review if needed
ci-bot: INF-7322 labeled P0 and added to sprint board
sam: timeline: python PR by EOD Thu with unit tests + CI smoke; ashley: TS PR Fri AM; ben: docs after both land
maria: add integration smoke hitting staging to verify outputs for omit vs explicit empty stop case\ashley: will also run internal consumers checklist before merge
ben: will draft docs blurb and ping legal/compat if needed
maria: thanks all :thumbsup: — please paste PR links and CI results here and we can close INF-7322 when merged
ashley: ping @maria if I need quick review on generator changes
sam: will post PR link here when opened
maria: closing loop — prioritize this sprint due to alpha customer risk
